LET.desc: Assigns names to values and uses them in a final calculation.

args.name: calculation
args.help: the calculation using the names above

PERCENTOF.desc: Returns the sum of a subset divided by the sum of all data.

COMBINA.desc: Returns the number of combinations with repetitions for a given number of items.

args.name: number_chosen
args.help: number of items in each combination

PERMUTATIONA.desc: Returns the number of permutations with repetitions (number ^ number_chosen).

args.name: number_chosen
args.help: number of items in each permutation

CEILING.MATH.desc: Rounds a number up to the nearest integer or multiple of significance.

args.name: mode
args.help: if nonzero, rounds negatives away from zero (optional)

FLOOR.MATH.desc: Rounds a number down to the nearest integer or multiple of significance.

args.name: mode
args.help: if nonzero, rounds negatives toward zero (optional)

BASE.desc: Converts a number into text in the given radix (base).

DECIMAL.desc: Converts a text representation of a number in a given base to a decimal number.

ARABIC.desc: Converts a Roman numeral to an Arabic number.

RRI.desc: Returns an equivalent interest rate for the growth of an investment.

PDURATION.desc: Returns the number of periods required by an investment to reach a value.

BITAND.desc: Returns a bitwise AND of two numbers.

BITOR.desc: Returns a bitwise OR of two numbers.

BITXOR.desc: Returns a bitwise XOR of two numbers.

BITLSHIFT.desc: Returns a number shifted left by the given number of bits.

args.name: shift_amount
args.help: bits to shift left (negative shifts right)

BITRSHIFT.desc: Returns a number shifted right by the given number of bits.

args.name: shift_amount
args.help: bits to shift right (negative shifts left)

HELLO.desc: Returns a greeting — EGTools++ connectivity test.

IMAGE.desc: Inserts a picture into a cell from a source URL or file path.

args.name: sizing
args.help: 0 fit & keep ratio, 1 fill, 2 original size, 3 custom (optional)

args.name: height
args.help: height in pixels when sizing is 3 (optional)

args.name: width
args.help: width in pixels when sizing is 3 (optional)

SEQ2D.desc: Returns a rows×cols array of sequential numbers.

XLOOKUP.desc: Searches a range or array for a match and returns the corresponding item from a second range or array.

args.name: lookup_array
args.help: the range or array to search

args.name: return_array
args.help: the range or array to return from

args.name: if_not_found
args.help: value to return if no match (optional)

IFNA.desc: Returns value_if_na if the value is the #N/A error; otherwise the value.

UNICHAR.desc: Returns the Unicode character for the given number (code point).

UNICODE.desc: Returns the Unicode code point of the first character of the text.

args.name: text
args.help: text whose first character is examined

DECODEURL.desc: Decodes a percent-encoded (URL) string back to text.

XOR.desc: Returns the logical exclusive OR of the arguments (TRUE for an odd count of TRUEs).

NUMBERVALUE.desc: Converts text to a number in a locale-independent way.

DAYS.desc: Returns the number of days between two dates (end − start).

ISOWEEKNUM.desc: Returns the ISO 8601 week number of the year for a date.

FORMULATEXT.desc: Returns the formula of the referenced cell as text.

ISFORMULA.desc: Returns TRUE if the referenced cell contains a formula.

SHEET.desc: Returns the sheet number of a reference (or the current sheet).

SHEETS.desc: Returns the number of sheets in the workbook (or in a reference).

FILTERXML.desc: Returns data from XML content using the specified XPath.

WEBSERVICE.desc: Returns the response from a web service at the URL (HTTP GET).

IFS.desc: Checks conditions in order and returns the value for the first TRUE condition.

SWITCH.desc: Compares an expression to values and returns the first matching result (or default).

MAXIFS.desc: Returns the maximum of cells that meet all criteria.

MINIFS.desc: Returns the minimum of cells that meet all criteria.

TEXTJOIN.desc: Joins text using a delimiter, optionally ignoring empty cells.

CONCAT.desc: Concatenates text from values and ranges (no delimiter).

XMATCH.desc: Returns the position of a lookup value within an array.

FILTER.desc: Filters an array, keeping rows/columns where include is TRUE.

SORT.desc: Sorts an array by a row/column.

args.name: by_col
args.help: TRUE to sort columns instead of rows

SORTBY.desc: Sorts an array by values in other arrays.

UNIQUE.desc: Returns the unique rows (or columns) of an array.

args.name: exactly_once
args.help: TRUE to keep items appearing once

SEQUENCE.desc: Generates a sequence of numbers as an array.

RANDARRAY.desc: Returns an array of random numbers.

TEXTSPLIT.desc: Splits text into an array using column and row delimiters.

TEXTBEFORE.desc: Returns the text before a delimiter.

args.name: instance_num
args.help: which occurrence, negative from the end (default 1)

args.name: match_end
args.help: 1 treats the end of text as a delimiter (default 0)

TEXTAFTER.desc: Returns the text after a delimiter.

args.name: instance_num
args.help: which occurrence, negative from the end (default 1)

args.name: match_end
args.help: 1 treats the end of text as a delimiter (default 0)

VSTACK.desc: Stacks arrays vertically into one array.

HSTACK.desc: Stacks arrays horizontally into one array.

TAKE.desc: Returns rows/columns from the start or end of an array.

DROP.desc: Removes rows/columns from the start or end of an array.

TOROW.desc: Returns the array as a single row.

TOCOL.desc: Returns the array as a single column.

CHOOSEROWS.desc: Returns the specified rows from an array.

CHOOSECOLS.desc: Returns the specified columns from an array.

EXPAND.desc: Expands an array to the given size, padding with a value.

WRAPROWS.desc: Wraps a vector into a 2D array, a set number of values per row.

WRAPCOLS.desc: Wraps a vector into a 2D array, a set number of values per column.

TRIMRANGE.desc: Trims blank rows/columns from the edges of an array.

ARRAYTOTEXT.desc: Returns a text representation of an array.

VALUETOTEXT.desc: Returns the text representation of a value.

REGEXTEST.desc: Tests whether text matches a regular expression.

REGEXEXTRACT.desc: Extracts matches of a regular expression from text.

args.name: return_mode
args.help: 0 first match, 1 all matches, 2 capture groups

REGEXREPLACE.desc: Replaces text matching a regular expression ($1.. backrefs).

GROUPBY.desc: Groups rows by key(s) and aggregates values. Aggregator is text: SUM/AVERAGE/COUNT/COUNTA/MAX/MIN/PRODUCT/MEDIAN/MODE.SNGL/STDEV.S/STDEV.P/VAR.S/VAR.P/CONCAT/ARRAYTOTEXT/PERCENTOF + extensions (param via relative_to): TEXTJOIN/LARGE/SMALL/PERCENTILE·QUARTILE(.INC/.EXC).

args.name: function
args.help: aggregator text: one of SUM/AVERAGE/COUNT/COUNTA/MAX/MIN/PRODUCT/MEDIAN/MODE.SNGL/STDEV.S/STDEV.P/VAR.S/VAR.P/CONCAT/ARRAYTOTEXT/PERCENTOF + extensions (param via relative_to): TEXTJOIN/LARGE/SMALL/PERCENTILE·QUARTILE(.INC/.EXC)

args.name: field_headers
args.help: 0 none/hide, 1 has/hide, 2 none/show generated, 3 has/show (default auto)

args.name: total_depth
args.help: 0 none, 1 grand total (default), 2 grand+subtotals; negative = at top

args.name: sort_order
args.help: output column number(s), negative descending, e.g. {2,-1}

args.name: relative_to
args.help: extension-aggregator parameter: TEXTJOIN delimiter, LARGE/SMALL k, PERCENTILE p (0-1), QUARTILE 0-4

PIVOTBY.desc: Pivots data by row and column keys. Aggregator is text (SUM, COUNT, …).

args.name: function
args.help: aggregator text: one of SUM/AVERAGE/COUNT/COUNTA/MAX/MIN/PRODUCT/MEDIAN/MODE.SNGL/STDEV.S/STDEV.P/VAR.S/VAR.P/CONCAT/ARRAYTOTEXT/PERCENTOF + extensions (param via relative_to): TEXTJOIN/LARGE/SMALL/PERCENTILE·QUARTILE(.INC/.EXC)

args.name: row_total_depth
args.help: 0 none, 1 grand total (default); negative = at top

args.name: row_sort_order
args.help: row sort: column number, negative descending

args.name: col_total_depth
args.help: 0 none, 1 total column (default); negative = at left

args.name: relative_to
args.help: PERCENTOF base 0-2 (0 grand default); for extension aggregators the parameter: TEXTJOIN delimiter, LARGE/SMALL k, PERCENTILE p (0-1), QUARTILE 0-4

JSONFILTER.desc: Parses JSON text into a two-column (path, value) table.

args.name: key_path
args.help: path to filter, e.g. "data.items[0].name" (default: whole document)

BARCODE.desc: Encodes text as a barcode and inserts the image into the calling cell.

args.name: type
args.help: QRCODE (default), CODE128, DATAMATRIX, EAN13/8, ITF, PDF417, AZTEC, CODE39/93, UPC-A/E, CODABAR, GS1-128/DM/QR

args.name: option
args.help: number = margin (2D types) or TRUE = show text below (1D types)

QRCODE.desc: Encodes text as a QR code image in the calling cell.

args.name: gs1
args.help: TRUE = treat text as GS1 (AI)value pairs

DATAMATRIX.desc: Encodes text as a DataMatrix image in the calling cell.

args.name: gs1
args.help: TRUE = treat text as GS1 (AI)value pairs

CODE128.desc: Encodes text as a Code 128 barcode image in the calling cell.

args.name: show_text
args.help: TRUE = draw the text under the bars

READBARCODE.desc: Decodes a barcode from an image file or URL.

args.name: source
args.help: local file path or http(s) URL

args.name: result_type
args.help: 1 text (default), 2 code text, 3 format, 4 symbology id, 5 raw hex; array like {1,3} allowed

READGS1.desc: Splits GS1 text into (AI), value rows.

args.name: gs1_text
args.help: (AI)value form or a decoded barcode string

DISPLAYCOLOR.desc: Returns the displayed fill or font color of each cell in a range.

args.name: font
args.help: TRUE = font color instead of fill (default FALSE)

COUNTIFCOLOR.desc: Counts cells whose displayed color matches a reference cell.

args.name: color_cell
args.help: cell holding the reference color (first cell used)

SUMIFCOLOR.desc: Sums cells whose displayed color matches a reference cell.

args.name: color_cell
args.help: cell holding the reference color (first cell used)

ISVISIBLE.desc: Returns whether each cell in a range is visible (row and column not hidden).

VISIBLEAGGR.desc: Lists or aggregates only the visible cells of a range.

args.name: option
args.help: TEXTJOIN delimiter, LARGE/SMALL k, PERCENTILE p (0-1), QUARTILE quart (0-4)

ILOOKUP.desc: Finds a match and copies the picture anchored at the matched cell into the calling cell.

args.name: lookup_array
args.help: the array or range to search

args.name: image_range
args.help: range whose cells anchor the pictures

args.name: match_mode
args.help: 0 exact (default), -1 next smaller, 1 next larger, 2 wildcard, 3 regex

args.name: info
args.help: output column(s) 1-27, e.g. {1,2}: 1 zip, 2 road addr (default), 3 jibun, 4 english

args.name: row
args.help: result row to return; 0/omitted = all rows

args.name: api_key
args.help: juso.go.kr key; entered once, then stored in the registry

BRNSTATUS.desc: Checks Korean business-registration-number status (NTS via data.go.kr).

args.name: api_key
args.help: data.go.kr key; entered once, then stored in the registry

GEOSEARCH.desc: Searches an address or place and returns GPS coordinates (VWorld).

args.name: api_key
args.help: vworld.kr key; entered once, then stored in the registry

GEOCODER.desc: Returns the GPS coordinate of an address (VWorld; road then jibun).

args.name: api_key
args.help: vworld.kr key; entered once, then stored in the registry

GEOADDRESS.desc: Returns the address at a coordinate (VWorld reverse geocoding).

args.name: api_key
args.help: vworld.kr key; entered once, then stored in the registry

ADDRESSMAP.desc: Inserts a cadastral map picture for an address into the calling cell (VWorld WMS).

args.name: api_key
args.help: vworld.kr key; entered once, then stored in the registry

EVAL.desc: Evaluates a formula given as text and returns the result.

DIRFOLDER.desc: Lists the files (and optionally folders) of a directory.

SHEETLIST.desc: Returns the visible sheet names of the calling workbook.

args.name: start
args.help: first sheet number or name (default: first)

args.name: end
args.help: last sheet number or name (default: last)

TOTALPAGES.desc: Total number of pages with the current print settings (recalculate before printing).

args.name: ignore_start
args.help: TRUE numbers from 1, ignoring the first-page-number setting

RESTAPI.desc: Calls a REST API and returns the response text.

args.name: request_headers
args.help: two-column range of header name/value pairs

EXRATE.desc: Looks up the KRW standard exchange rate for a date (up to 10 days back).

IMPORTTEXT.desc: Imports data from a text-based file (local path or URL) as an array.

args.name: delimiter
args.help: delimiter text (default tab), or ascending numbers like {1,3} for fixed-width columns

args.name: skip_rows
args.help: rows to skip; negative skips from the end

args.name: take_rows
args.help: rows to take; negative takes from the end

IMPORTCSV.desc: Imports a CSV file (local path or URL) as an array — comma delimiter, UTF-8.

args.name: skip_rows
args.help: rows to skip; negative skips from the end

args.name: take_rows
args.help: rows to take; negative takes from the end
